scope: Reconcile DXF-only peer route contracts and current report state against existing explicit-geometry, ACIS-carrier, polyface-wire and peer-admission owners.

method.kind: Read-only primary-source web research plus local plan/test inspection
localInspection: DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md existing netDxf/IxMilia/dxf-rs peer scopes and generated polyface progress
tests/dxf_fixture_tests.cpp direct ASCII/binary polyface VERTEX group-70 assertions
method.evidenceRule: Peer READMEs and issues establish only their stated route, version, artifact and self-reported status. Class presence, self-roundtrip, aggregate percentages and open issue reports do not qualify libdxfrw or native consumer semantics.

evidence.topic: Archived netDxf is an explicit-DXF peer, not an ACIS peer
evidence.observed: The archived README advertises ASCII/binary DXF R2000-R2018 and lists explicit mesh/PFACE and 3DFACE entities, while explicitly saying REGION, SURFACE and 3DSOLID depend on undocumented proprietary data and cannot be read.
doesNotEstablish: native application acceptance for this repository's output
evidence.planUse: Retain as historical optional explicit-geometry comparator only; never count its SOLID/Mesh naming as modeler-solid support.

evidence.topic: IxMilia typed class/version surface is narrower than native writer acceptance
evidence.observed: The README describes DXF/DXB read/write and R10-R2014 support with named entity exceptions and warns AutoCAD may reject output for typed 3DSOLID/BODY/REGION and other classes; it also notes required-field and R13 caveats.
doesNotEstablish: uniform support for all entities across R10-R2014
evidence.planUse: Keep parse, typed model, serialization, reopen and native acceptance as distinct comparator outcomes.

evidence.topic: dxf-rs polyface flag issue remains open but local raw-wire test covers the claimed failure class
evidence.observed: Issue #96 remains open and reports VERTEX group 70 changing from in-memory 192 to serialized 128. The local generated test asserts literal ASCII and binary VERTEX role values 192,192,192,128 plus parent type, order, signed face indices and zero terminator behavior.
doesNotEstablish: the current dxf-rs artifact still exhibits the report
evidence.planUse: Do not duplicate the local test or use a peer readback as a substitute for direct wire inspection.

evidence.observed: The current table totals 3911 decoded + 525 skipped + 9 errors = 4445 records; 3911/4445 rounds to 88.0%. The AC1032 row is 776 decoded, 57 skipped, 9 errored, yielding 92.2%. The README explains its prior 95.6% used a smaller ten-file set, but a later verification paragraph still cites 90.3% aggregate and 85.9% AC1032, inconsistent with the current table.
doesNotEstablish: a matched comparison against libdxfrw's corpus
a pinned peer source or executable result
evidence.planUse: Describe the table as internally arithmetical and the verification paragraph as stale/conflicting; only exact per-version/per-family outcomes over identical inputs may be compared.
